pages.text: Materials used to craft the Singularity and Singularity Ingots.$(br2)These include Imitated Bedrock, Rune Catalysts, Unnatural Catalysts, Infinity Panakeia, and Imitated Bedrock Ingots.$(br2)They are advanced alchemy materials mainly handled at the Transcendental Table.

pages.title: Imitated Bedrock
pages.text: A material modeled after bedrock, used in many late-game materials and equipment.

pages.title: Rune Catalyst
pages.text: An advanced alchemy material used on the path to the Singularity.

pages.title: Unnatural Catalyst
pages.text: An advanced alchemy material used on the path to the Singularity.

pages.title: Infinity Panakeia
pages.text: An extremely high-tier Panakeia used in Singularity-related crafting.

pages.title: Imitated Bedrock Ingot
pages.text: A major Singularity-related material made by further processing Imitated Bedrock.
